name: SMC Electrical Products
old_description: Becker/SMC was originally established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. From the beginning, Becker/SMC focused on quality products and service to meet customers’ needs. Becker/SMC designs and manufactures electrical components, open-type and explosion proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls and power distribution equipment for a variety of industries.
about:
Becker/SMC was established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. The company, now based in Bristol, Virginia, operates over 90,000 square feet of manufacturing space. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures electrical components including open-type and explosion-proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls, power distribution equipment, transformers, vacuum switches, connectors, and electronic monitoring devices. A Custom Equipment Operation uses parametric engineering and lean manufacturing to turn customer specifications into precision products. The facility employs a skilled workforce that follows strict quality assurance protocols.

Becker/SMC serves a variety of industries, with a notable presence in the transit sector following the acquisition of OB Systems. OB Systems’ rectifiers, AC and DC switchgear, traction power substations, and trolley hardware are supplied to heavy and light rail systems across North America. The company also supports mining operations with longwall controls and provides power distribution for general industrial applications.

The company emphasizes its role as an innovator, stating that most major innovations and specialized electrical components have been developed in-house. Its vision focuses on delivering best-in-class products and services, backed by seven facility expansions and a commitment to regulatory compliance.
